necessary_context.content: F_p(Delta,L_1:p): F:R^d->R is C^p, F(0)-inf F<=Delta; derivative q is globally L_q-Lipschitz in operator norm. Vector norm is Euclidean; Hessian error uses operator norm. L1=infinity means no finite gradient Lipschitz requirement.
necessary_context.name: Function class and norms

necessary_context.content: For every query point x, gradient and symmetric Hessian estimators are unbiased; E||G(x,z)-grad F(x)||^2<=sigma1^2 and E||H(x,z)-Hess F(x)||op^2<=sigma2^2. Each query uses an independent fresh z. HVP is H(x,z)v; no same-seed multipoint access is needed. No function-value variance bound is needed.
necessary_context.locator: PDF p.6, (6)-(7), optimization protocol; p.8 Algorithm 1
necessary_context.name: Stochastic oracle

necessary_context.content: Appendix D (18) makes x_t measurable from prior estimates and independent algorithm seeds. Its varying b_t is independent of G^(t-1) and g_(t-1). The repaired local results use fixed deterministic b, avoiding any claim for arbitrary history-dependent reset probabilities.
necessary_context.name: Adaptive-query restriction
